Amanda

Key functions define the basic shape of the detection function.  Key functions commonly used in distance sampling are the half normal and the hazard rate. Adjustment terms can be added to the key function to add additional flexibility.

A more complete discussion of modelling detection functions with key functions and adjustment terms can be found in our online course materials.  Have a look at the lecture "Choosing a detection function" in Chapter 1 (Introduction):

https://workshops.distancesampling.org/online-course/syllabus/Chapter1/#choosing-a-detection-function

specifically slides 7-20.

Hope that is helpful.
